# Lucide icon provenance

Huterm embeds selected SVG icons from the `lucide-static` npm package version
1.45.0. The package is licensed under ISC. Some selected icons are derived from
Feather Icons and are also covered by the MIT notice included in the package's
license file.

Source package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide-static/v/1.45.0>

The complete upstream copyright and license text is in `LICENSE` alongside this
file and accompanies the packaged application.
